name: compare
description: Two peer options side by side at an exact 50/50 split — deliberately even, unlike `split`'s 60/40 diagram weighting: here neither side outranks the other, so neither gets more room. Each side carries a bold heading plus bullets; author them as `sides[]` in left-first order.

sides.description: exactly two entries; index 0 is the LEFT side, index 1 the RIGHT; each has `heading` and `bullets`
